Text:
Teachers at Adventist schools in Zimbabwe are striking, demanding five months of overdue pay.

Imagine dedicating yourself to educating the next generation, only to face months without a salary. That's the reality for teachers at Adventist schools across Zimbabwe, who have now taken the difficult step of striking. Their classrooms are empty, not by choice, but out of desperation, as they struggle to feed their families and meet basic needs.

This isn't just about unpaid wages; it's about the future of education and the well-being of those who shape young minds. The impact of this industrial action extends beyond the teachers themselves, affecting students whose learning is disrupted and communities that rely on these institutions. 🙏
